request.task: Adapt the character into one Tower Defense Unit from a faithful subset of the supplied source evidence. Plan the character's repertoire and three behaviorally distinct paths before choosing numbers, then implement one automatic base attack and all fifteen purchases with the supported mechanics. Use build codes such as 0-0-0, 3-x-x and 1-2-0. Preserve source ownership and story period, list behavior the Definition cannot express as unsupported mechanics, and label all numbers and prices as proposals. Do not claim canon verification or balance.

documents.text:
Dart Monkey is a primary tower. Placement costs 200 at Medium. Its base attack throws one dart every 0.95 seconds at range 32; each dart deals 1 sharp damage and can hit 2 bloons. It cannot target Camo bloons, and its sharp darts cannot damage Lead or Frozen bloons.

Top path. Sharp Shots (140) raises dart pierce to 3. Razor Sharp Shots (200) raises it to 5. Spike-o-pult (320) replaces the dart with a spiked ball thrown every 1.15 seconds at range 36.8 that deals 2 damage, hits up to 18 bloons, rebounds off obstacles and can damage Frozen bloons. Juggernaut (1800) throws every second, raises pierce to 60, damages Lead, adds 3 damage against Ceramic and 2 against Fortified bloons and knocks light bloons back. Ultra-Juggernaut (15000) deals 5 damage with pierce 210 and larger Ceramic, Fortified and Lead bonuses; when its pierce runs out it splits into two rings of six smaller balls that each deal 2 damage with pierce 50.

Middle path. Quick Shots (100) shortens the attack interval to 0.8075 seconds. Very Quick Shots (190) shortens it to 0.6365 seconds. Triple Shot (450) throws three darts in a 30 degree arc every 0.477 seconds. Super Monkey Fan Club (7200) halves the interval again and adds an activated ability: for 15 seconds, up to 10 nearby Dart Monkeys with no path above tier 2 become super monkeys that attack about 16 times as often; the ability recharges in 50 seconds. Plasma Monkey Fan Club (45000) keeps that timing, affects up to 20 Dart Monkeys, and their plasma darts gain 1 damage and 3 pierce.

Bottom path. Long Range Darts (90) extends range to 40. Enhanced Eyesight (200) extends range to 48 and lets this Dart Monkey target Camo bloons. Crossbow (575) fires bolts that deal 3 damage with pierce 4 at range 60. Sharp Shooter (2050) deals 6 damage every 0.475 seconds, and every tenth shot is a critical hit for 50 damage. Crossbow Master (21500) deals 8 damage every 0.2375 seconds with pierce 8 at range 80, can damage every bloon type, and every fifth shot is a critical hit for 80 damage.

documents.text:
Character Tower Defense rules, version 12, for the BTD6-inspired default Profile. Editable starter rules, not Manga Mayhem rules, BTD6 canon or balance certification. The structured mechanicsDefinition owns executable operators, numerical limits and the starter scale. The atlas references below show scale and progression shape; they are not kits to copy.

Source fidelity. Adapt the character's sourced attacks, weapons, forms, sensory powers and interactions. Respect ownership, prerequisites and story period: another actor using a power does not establish that this character owns it, and former or conditional powers keep their limits. Keep invented Tower Defense interactions separate from canon claims. A revision that only edits wording keeps every supplied mechanic; a redesign names each deliberate change and never resolves a contradiction silently.

Build codes. Paths are top, middle and bottom, with five sequential purchases each. Write builds top-middle-bottom: 0-0-0 is the base Unit; 1-x-x to 5-x-x are top purchases, x-1-x to x-5-x middle and x-x-1 to x-x-5 bottom; x means unspecified, not a free purchase; 1-2-0 is a concrete build. A Unit buys at most two paths and only one beyond its second purchase: 3-2-0 is legal, 3-3-0 and 1-1-1 are not. Purchased effects persist unless a later purchase explicitly replaces them.

Activation. Only the middle path may have a player-activated ability, first at x-4-x; top and bottom stay automatic, and choosing a targeting priority is not an activation. In this Definition the ability is one manual boost of the Unit's purchased attack: x-4-x unlocks it and x-5-x may modify that same boost. A second x-5-x Active, a ground-targeted strike, a separate Active attack, allied restoration and dispels cannot be expressed. Record them as unsupported mechanics and keep them out of names and wording.

Purchase roles. The first and second purchase of each path are small readable foundations that stay useful as crosspaths: they improve the existing attack and may add personal detection, never a broad all-source damage buff. The third purchase creates a reason to commit: a new behavior, a substantial improvement or a narrower job. The fourth and fifth develop, add or replace behavior, access, capacity or uptime as the path's role requires; they need not add a subsystem each time, but a fifth purchase that only raises ordinary damage is a token step, not a capstone. Keep the three paths behaviorally distinct and use no universal capstone multiplier.

Actions. For every changed action state its trigger, target, delivery, timing, effect, inheritance and limit. Say adds when behavior coexists and replaces only when the earlier behavior stops. Do not invent shared cooldowns or suppress independent behavior. A transformation says what changes and what happens when it ends. Preserve the selected targeting and normal movement prediction of enemy-targeted attacks; ground-targeted effects are distinct. Damage, width, projectile count, area and pierce are separate properties. Chains, explosions, fragments, return passes and control need bounded hit capacity and a stated repeat-hit or pierce-refresh rule. Bound support and control by eligibility, capacity, locality or downtime; no unbounded multi-copy support or control loops.

Crosspaths. Code resolves every partial and full crosspath: the 12 early builds 1-1-0, 1-2-0, 1-0-1, 1-0-2, 2-1-0, 2-2-0, 2-0-1, 2-0-2, 0-1-1, 0-1-2, 0-2-1 and 0-2-2, and the 36 advanced builds where one path is at 3 or more and another at 1 or 2. A side purchase changes the one attack and, when owned, the middle boost of that attack. Know which of them receives each change of damage, speed, range, detection, pierce and statuses; do not invent a special synergy for every combination.

Match rules. A stationary Unit attacks detected enemies in range along a clear delivery path; detection grants neither delivery nor damage access. Gold is match currency and Health the shared life pool, 150 at the start; Units have no Health. The basic enemy has one layer removed by 1 damage; tougher enemies need explicit rules, and no layer tree or leak simulation exists. A player may own one placed 5-x-x, x-5-x or x-x-5 per Unit type and path at a time; the caller enforces this from match state.

Engine boundary. The Definition supports one automatic base attack with its delivery, damage type, targeting, detection and status effects, one manual boost of that attack on the middle path, distinct-target volleys and bounded follow-ups. Summons, independent or ground-targeted attacks, separate Actives, allied buffs, restoration, shields, armor-only damage, magazines, reloads, critical counters, rebounds, knockback, economy and movement are unsupported: list them as unsupported mechanics. An ordinary damage stat never implements shield bypass, armor-only damage or restoration, and a name or sentence never grants missing behavior. The vocabulary names every status effect, damage type, targeting mode and detection trait; no other exists.

Private design checks, never printed in the unit: why a player buys each path, which weakness remains, why a capstone beats more fourth-purchase copies, whether cheap copies stack into loops, and a review for missing effects, illegal builds, unsupported character claims, lost purchased benefits, reductions presented as upgrades, extra activation buttons, control loops and crosspaths that fail after a transformation. Code measures ordinary-target throughput, group capacity, control, reach and active windows analytically; that is evidence for review, not balance.

Unit output. The rendered unit starts with the character name and 0-0-0, then each purchase by build code with its exact numbers in ordinary sentences, the crosspath builds and the unsupported mechanics. It carries no strategy, balance verdicts, capability reports, rules recaps or review certificates. Names and wording use direct sentences and consistent terms; no filler, promotional wording, usage advice, em dashes or en dashes. Patch notes, when requested, separate changed mechanics from wording fixes.

Scale references from btd6-atlas capture 56.3, Steam build 24829026, repository revision a380413 (https://github.com/KyleDerZweite/btd6-atlas/tree/a380413ed809c98654acec7aa37cba40f80bf5c5/data/56.3-build-24829026). Prices are Medium incremental purchases; files are under game-data/Towers and game-data/Upgrades. Damage per second assumes a target always in range and ignores enemy-class bonuses unless stated.

Dart Monkey 0-0-0 (DartMonkey.json): 200 Gold; one dart every 0.95 s at range 32, 1 sharp damage, pierce 2; no Camo detection; sharp damage cannot hurt Lead or Frozen. 1.05 damage per second on one target; one throw deals at most 2 damage in total.

Group capacity, Dart Monkey top (DartMonkey-100 to -500): 1-0-0 Sharp Shots 140, pierce 3. 2-0-0 Razor Sharp Shots 200, pierce 5. 3-0-0 Spike-o-pult 320 replaces the dart with a rebounding spiked ball: 2 damage, pierce 18, every 1.15 s, range 36.8, can hurt Frozen. 4-0-0 Juggernaut 1800: every 1.0 s, pierce 60, can hurt Lead, +3 damage to Ceramic and +2 to Fortified, knockback. 5-0-0 Ultra-Juggernaut 15000: 5 damage, pierce 210, larger Ceramic, Fortified and Lead bonuses; when its pierce runs out the ball splits into two rings of six balls with 2 damage and pierce 50 each. Damage capacity per throw grows 2, 5, 36, 120 and 2250 while single-target damage per second grows only from 1.05 to 5: the branch buys group capacity and access, not ordinary damage.

Precision, Dart Monkey bottom (DartMonkey-001 to -005): 0-0-1 Long Range Darts 90, range 40. 0-0-2 Enhanced Eyesight 200, range 48 and personal Camo detection. 0-0-3 Crossbow 575: 3 damage, pierce 4, range 60. 0-0-4 Sharp Shooter 2050: 6 damage every 0.475 s; every tenth shot is a 50-damage critical. 0-0-5 Crossbow Master 21500: 8 damage every 0.2375 s, pierce 8, range 80, hurts every type; every fifth shot is an 80-damage critical. Counting a critical shot as its critical damage, single-target damage per second is 3.2, about 22 and about 94: each advanced purchase multiplies precise damage and the capstone also adds reach, pierce and access.

Attack speed with an allied active, Dart Monkey middle (DartMonkey-010 to -050): 0-1-0 Quick Shots 100, every 0.8075 s. 0-2-0 Very Quick Shots 190, every 0.6365 s. 0-3-0 Triple Shot 450: three darts in a 30 degree arc every 0.477 s. 0-4-0 Super Monkey Fan Club 7200: every 0.239 s; an activated ability for 15 s, recharging in 50 s, turns up to 10 nearby Dart Monkeys with no path above 2 into super monkeys that attack at about 0.063 times their interval. 0-5-0 Plasma Monkey Fan Club 45000: same timing, up to 20 monkeys, +1 damage and +3 pierce on their darts. Darts per second grow 1.05, 1.24, 1.57, 6.3 and 12.6; most value of x-4-x and x-5-x lies in allies, which this Definition cannot express.

Attack speed with a self active, Boomerang Monkey middle (BoomerangMonkey.json and -010 to -050): base 315 Gold, 1 damage every 1.2 s, pierce 4, range 43, returning flight. 0-1-0 Faster Throwing 175, every 0.9 s. 0-2-0 Faster Rangs 250, every 0.6 s. 0-3-0 Bionic Boomerang 1250: every 0.15 s, 8 times the base frequency, and +1 damage to MOAB-class enemies. 0-4-0 Turbo Charge 4200: activated for 10 s, recharging in 45 s: interval times 0.2 and +1 damage. 0-5-0 Perma Charge 35000: permanently every 0.03 s with 4 damage; its active adds 10 damage for 15 s, recharging in 45 s. Single-target damage per second is 0.83, 6.7 at 0-3-0, 67 during the 0-4-0 active (22 percent uptime), 133 permanently at 0-5-0 and 467 during its active. Pierce stays 4, so group capacity grows only through frequency.

Single target with blimp control, Sniper Monkey top (SniperMonkey.json and -100 to -500): base 350 Gold, instant 2 damage every 1.59 s on one target anywhere on the map; no Camo detection; cannot hurt Lead or Frozen. 1-0-0 Full Metal Jacket 350: 4 damage and Lead and Frozen access. 2-0-0 Large Calibre 1300: 7 damage. 3-0-0 Deadly Precision 2200: 20 damage and +50 to Ceramic. 4-0-0 Maim MOAB 6300: 30 damage; each hit immobilizes MOAB-class enemies for 3 s on a MOAB down to 0.75 s on a ZOMG or DDT. 5-0-0 Cripple MOAB 32000: 140 damage, immobilizes for up to 7 s, hit MOAB-class enemies take 5 extra damage per hit, and each hit bursts for 28 damage on up to 10 enemies within 8. Damage per second is 1.3, 2.5, 4.4, 12.6, 18.9 and 88: the fourth purchase adds control access more than damage; the capstone multiplies damage and adds control uptime, vulnerability and a bounded burst.

Control, Ice Monkey top (IceMonkey.json and -100 to -500): base 400 Gold; every 2.4 s it freezes up to 40 non-MOAB enemies within 20 for 1.5 s and deals 1 damage; no Camo detection; cannot hurt Lead or White. 1-0-0 Permafrost 150: frozen enemies keep a 50 percent slow. 2-0-0 Metal Freeze 350: can freeze Lead. 3-0-0 Ice Shards 1500: range 25 and a shard effect on frozen enemies. 4-0-0 Embrittlement 2300: also slows MOAB-class enemies and freezes 3 layers instead of 2. 5-0-0 Super Brittle 28000: every 1.56 s, 5 damage, every type, 6 layers. Control exists at the base; purchases add persistence, access and uptime (freeze covers 1.5 s of every 2.4 s, then of every 1.56 s), not ordinary damage.

Burst active, Tack Shooter middle (TackShooter.json and -010 to -050): base 260 Gold, a ring of 8 tacks every 1.12 s, 1 damage and pierce 1 each, range 23. 0-1-0 Long Range Tacks 100, range 26.9. 0-2-0 Super Range Tacks 225, range 30.8 and pierce 4. 0-3-0 Blade Shooter 550: blades with pierce 8, range 46, can hurt Frozen. 0-4-0 Blade Maelstrom 2700: 2 damage; an activated spin for 3 s, recharging in 20 s, fires 2 blades every 0.045 s with pierce 100 and 2 damage. 0-5-0 Super Maelstrom 15000: 5 damage, +5 to Ceramic, every type; the spin lasts 9 s on the same 20 s recharge. Ring damage capacity per second is 7, 29, 57, 114 and 286; the spin far exceeds it while it lasts, and its uptime rises from 15 to 45 percent.

Support, Monkey Village (MonkeyVillage.json, -100, -200 and -020): base 1200 Gold and no attack; allied towers within 40 gain 10 percent range. 1-0-0 Bigger Radius 400, radius 48. 2-0-0 Jungle Drums 1500, allies attack 15 percent faster. 0-2-0 Radar Scanner 2000, allies in the radius can target Camo. Allied buffs and shared detection have no operator here; list them as unsupported mechanics.

Roster shape from the atlas patterns (patterns/towers.md and progression.md): 26 standard towers; primary base prices 200 to 400; tier medians about 200 to 275 for a first purchase, 1500 to 2000 for a third, 4000 to 6500 for a fourth and 30000 to 38000 for a fifth. Final-to-previous purchase price ratios range from 1.58 to 19.64 with median 6.15; they describe prices, not output, and are not a capstone multiplier. The middle fourth purchase carries an ability in 25 of 26 towers and the fifth keeps it; top and bottom fourth purchases show one each. No fifth purchase above changes only ordinary damage.

Health and layer values are starter assumptions. All generated values and prices are proposals that need playtesting.

constraints.text: Camo detection arrives only through Enhanced Eyesight on the bottom path and applies to this Unit alone. There is no allied revealing.
Lead damage arrives only through Juggernaut on the top path or Crossbow Master on the bottom path. Attack speed and range purchases do not grant it.
The Fan Club ability transforms other nearby Dart Monkeys. Only this Unit's own share of the ability may be modeled as a manual boost; the allied transformation stays an unsupported mechanic.

findings.subject: Middle path x-5-x Plasma Monkey Fan Club
findings.rule: Compiled mechanics must implement each planned milestone and capstone value.
findings.message: The plan's x-5-x milestone says only boosted plasma darts gain damage and pierce and that the ordinary x-4-x volleys are unchanged, and the capstone value says x-5-x matches x-4-x outside the window. The compiled x-5-x raises pierce from 2 to 5 on every dart at all times, so sustained group damage rate rises from 25.1 to 62.7. proposal-8 discloses the change, but the retained plan and path weakness still describe the old behavior, and source1:13 gives the extra pierce only to the affected monkeys' plasma darts during the ability.
findings.action: Decide one version: either drop the sustained +3 pierce so x-5-x modifies only the boost, or keep it and rewrite the x-5-x milestone, capstone value and path weakness to state that every dart gains 3 pierce at all times.

findings.subject: Middle path x-4-x Super Monkey Surge
findings.rule: A source factor should concern this character's own attack, and a numerical adaptation should keep paths behaviorally distinct.
findings.message: source1:12 gives the roughly 16 times attack rate to nearby Dart Monkeys with no path above tier 2, about 25 darts per second for a converted 0-2-0 monkey. The compiled boost multiplies this Unit's already halved x-4-x triple volley interval by 0.0625, giving about 200 darts per second on one target, eight times that rate. Activated on every recharge, x-4-x (6940 Gold) averages about 69 direct damage per second, twice the x-x-5 sustained 33.7 at 19115 Gold, and 0-4-2 adds Camo, so the middle path overlaps the bottom path's durable target role except for Lead and Frozen. This is a power concern, not a proven contradiction.
findings.action: Choose the boost interval multiplier deliberately: either lower it toward the per monkey source rate, or record in the plan that 0.0625 on the triple volley is an intended compensation for the omitted allies.

findings.subject: Middle path x-5-x capstone value
findings.rule: A capstone should beat more fourth purchase copies for its incremental price.
findings.message: Four x-4-x copies cost 27760 Gold against 31940 for one x-5-x. The copies give 50.2 sustained direct damage per second against 12.5, 100.3 sustained group capacity against 62.7, and, if boosted together, 802 peak direct against 401. x-5-x leads only on boosted group peak, 2006 against 1605. Its 25000 Gold buys doubled boost damage and pierce, with no new access or uptime, so the plan's reason to buy one x-5-x rests on placement and activation count alone. Removing the sustained pierce would widen the gap.
findings.action: Give x-5-x a boost change that copies cannot match, such as boost range or a larger boosted damage multiplier, or lower its price, then recheck it against four x-4-x copies.

blueprint.name: Dart Monkey
blueprint.role: Automatic dart thrower with one Sharp projectile attack. The top path trades the dart for a high pierce spiked ball that gains Lead access, the middle path throws faster triple volleys with a timed self boost, and the bottom path fires long range Camo detecting bolts that gain Lead access at x-x-5.
blueprint.weakness: The base dart has pierce 2, cannot target Camo and cannot damage Lead or Frozen enemies. Camo detection comes only from x-x-2, Lead and Frozen access only from 4-x-x or x-x-5, and the middle path stays Sharp. The middle boost is down 35 s of every 50 s and needs player activation.

sourceFacts.quote: Its base attack throws one dart every 0.95 seconds at range 32; each dart deals 1 sharp damage and can hit 2 bloons.
It cannot target Camo bloons, and its sharp darts cannot damage Lead or Frozen bloons.
Top path. Sharp Shots (140) raises dart pierce to 3.
Razor Sharp Shots (200) raises it to 5.
Spike-o-pult (320) replaces the dart with a spiked ball thrown every 1.15 seconds at range 36.8 that deals 2 damage, hits up to 18 bloons, rebounds off obstacles and can damage Frozen bloons.
Juggernaut (1800) throws every second, raises pierce to 60, damages Lead, adds 3 damage against Ceramic and 2 against Fortified bloons and knocks light bloons back.

Ultra-Juggernaut (15000) deals 5 damage with pierce 210 and larger Ceramic, Fortified and Lead bonuses; when its pierce runs out it splits into two rings of six smaller balls that each deal 2 damage with pierce 50.
Middle path. Quick Shots (100) shortens the attack interval to 0.8075 seconds.
Very Quick Shots (190) shortens it to 0.6365 seconds.
Triple Shot (450) throws three darts in a 30 degree arc every 0.477 seconds.

Super Monkey Fan Club (7200) halves the interval again and adds an activated ability: for 15 seconds, up to 10 nearby Dart Monkeys with no path above tier 2 become super monkeys that attack about 16 times as often; the ability recharges in 50 seconds.
Plasma Monkey Fan Club (45000) keeps that timing, affects up to 20 Dart Monkeys, and their plasma darts gain 1 damage and 3 pierce.
Bottom path. Long Range Darts (90) extends range to 40.
Enhanced Eyesight (200) extends range to 48 and lets this Dart Monkey target Camo bloons.
Crossbow (575) fires bolts that deal 3 damage with pierce 4 at range 60.
Sharp Shooter (2050) deals 6 damage every 0.475 seconds, and every tenth shot is a critical hit for 50 damage.
Crossbow Master (21500) deals 8 damage every 0.2375 seconds with pierce 8 at range 80, can damage every bloon type, and every fifth shot is a critical hit for 80 damage.

findings.subject: Bottom path x-x-5 Crossbow Master
findings.rule: A revision keeps every mechanic the feedback does not change and gets the user's decision on each deliberate trade.
findings.message: The feedback asked x-x-5 only for the 21500 Gold price and pierce 8. With four changes per purchase, adding +4 pierce made the compiled x-x-5 drop the previous +2 damage, so 0-0-5 bolts deal 6 instead of the 8 in source1:18 and the previous unit. The plan and reserved-1 disclose this and call it the user's choice, but the unit lists no unresolved question or decision reference. Consequence: 0-0-5 direct damage falls from 33.7 to 25.3 per second at 24615 Gold, while 0-4-0 using its boost on every recharge averages about 69 per second on one non-Lead target at 8140 Gold by the analytic duty fraction, so the drop widens the already disclosed overlap between the middle boost and the bottom path's tough single enemy role.
findings.action: Ask the user to choose: keep bolt damage 6 at 0-0-5, keep damage 8 by dropping the +20 range change so range stays 60, or allow moving one x-x-5 change to another purchase. Record the answer as a decision before treating the revision as final.

findings.subject: Middle path x-5-x Plasma Monkey Fan Club at 45000 Gold
findings.rule: A capstone should give a reason to buy it over more fourth purchase copies for its incremental price.
findings.message: At the restored price 0-5-0 totals 53140 Gold and six 0-4-0 copies cost 48840. The copies give 75.2 sustained direct and 150.5 group damage per second against 12.5 and 62.7, and 1204 direct and 2408 group when boosted together against 401 and 2006. x-5-x no longer leads on any measured metric, including the boosted group peak it led at 25000 Gold. The plan discloses the concern and the feedback keeps x-5-x unchanged, so its value rests only on one placement, one sight line and one activation.
findings.action: Confirm with the user that x-5-x stays a placement and activation capstone at 45000 Gold, or authorize one boost change copies cannot match, such as a boost range bonus, then recheck it against six x-4-x copies.

findings.subject: Top path 5-x-x Ultra-Juggernaut Split Balls
findings.rule: Each planned milestone must match the resolved mechanics.
findings.message: The plan's 5-x-x milestone says the split balls strike up to twelve eligible enemies near the primary target other than the primary. The compiled follow-up excludes every enemy the ball already hit, and the ball has pierce 210, so the split reaches only nearby enemies the ball missed. Its measured share is small either way: 24 of the 1074 group capacity per second at 5-0-0.
findings.action: Rewrite the 5-x-x milestone to say the split balls strike only enemies within 12 map units that the ball did not hit; no mechanic change is needed.

reviewSummary: The revision applies the feedback: x-4-x costs 7200, x-5-x 45000 and x-x-5 21500 Gold, 0-0-5 bolts reach pierce 8, and the base attack, every other purchase, the Fan Club boost's 15 s duration and 50 s recharge and the crosspath compositions are unchanged. The plan now matches the compiled x-5-x sustained pierce, and the three confirmed constraints hold. The main open item is that the four-change limit made x-x-5 drop its +2 bolt damage, a trade the feedback did not request and the plan leaves to the user without a recorded decision. At the restored price x-5-x trails six x-4-x copies on every measured metric. This model review does not approve the Unit or certify balance.

designPlan.concept: Dart Monkey from BTD6 patch 56.3 as one automatic Sharp throwing Unit. The top path replaces the dart with a high pierce spiked ball that gains Lead and Frozen access at 4-x-x and a split ball follow-up at 5-x-x. The middle path throws faster triple volleys and unlocks a timed boost of this Unit's own attack at x-4-x. The bottom path extends reach, adds personal Camo detection at x-x-2 and fires bolts that gain Lead and Frozen access at x-x-5.

signature.name: Dart Throw
signature.adaptation: The Unit automatically throws a Sharp dart as a projectile at the enemy chosen by the player's targeting priority. Every path keeps this single projectile attack: the top path replaces the dart with a spiked ball, the middle path throws more darts more often, and the bottom path replaces the dart with long range bolts.

base.name: Dart Throw
base.behavior: At 0-0-0 the Unit throws one Sharp dart as a projectile at the enemy chosen by the player's targeting priority within range; the dart can hit up to two enemies, each at most once, applies no status, cannot target Camo enemies and cannot damage Lead or Frozen enemies.

path1.name: Spiked Ball
path1.buyFor: Dense groups of ordinary enemies moving together along the track, and from 4-x-x groups that contain Lead or Frozen enemies.
path1.weakness: Through 3-x-x the ball stays Sharp, so it cannot damage Lead or Frozen enemies until 4-x-x, and the path adds no Camo detection of its own; only an x-x-2 side purchase adds it. Damage per hit stays low, so single tough enemies take many throws, and 3-x-x throws less often than the 2-x-x dart. Rebound, knockback and the Ceramic, Fortified and Lead bonuses are not modeled, and the 5-x-x follow-up reaches at most twelve enemies near the primary target once per throw.

milestones.tier1: 1-x-x Sharp Shots raises the pierce of the thrown dart so each throw can hit one more enemy; damage, throw interval, range, the Sharp damage type and the selected targeting stay the same, and the added pierce carries into later top purchases and into middle and bottom crosspaths.
milestones.tier2: 2-x-x Razor Sharp Shots raises the dart's pierce again so each throw can hit more enemies; every other dart property stays the same, and the added pierce carries into later top purchases and crosspaths.
milestones.tier3: 3-x-x Spike-o-pult replaces the dart with a spiked ball that is still a Sharp projectile thrown at the enemy chosen by the player's targeting priority; the ball deals more damage per hit, has much higher pierce and slightly longer range, and is thrown slightly less often than the 2-x-x dart, as in the source, while middle speed and bottom range or Camo side purchases still apply to it.
milestones.tier4: 4-x-x Juggernaut changes the ball's damage type from Sharp to Normal so it can damage Lead and Frozen enemies, shortens the throw interval and raises the ball's pierce greatly; damage per hit, range and targeting stay at the 3-x-x values.
milestones.tier5: 5-x-x Ultra-Juggernaut raises the ball's damage and pierce and adds a follow-up: each time the ball hits its primary target, split balls strike up to twelve distinct eligible enemies near that target other than the primary, once each, for part of the ball's damage and without inheriting statuses; the follow-up does not refill pierce or repeat, and the ball keeps its Normal damage type, interval and range.

path1.capstoneValue: 5-x-x multiplies the ball's pierce, raises its damage per hit and adds a follow-up on every throw that strikes up to twelve more nearby enemies, so one placement handles denser groups per throw than several 4-x-x copies, whose balls each stop at 4-x-x pierce and damage. The higher damage per hit also means fewer throws for each tough enemy, and the whole package sits at one point on the track where placement space may be scarce.

crosspaths.contribution: Proposed early purchases: 1-x-x Sharp Shots raises the pierce of the thrown dart so each throw can hit one more enemy; damage, throw interval, range, the Sharp damage type and the selected targeting stay the same, and the added pierce carries into later top purchases and into middle and bottom crosspaths. 2-x-x Razor Sharp Shots raises the dart's pierce again so each throw can hit more enemies; every other dart property stays the same, and the added pierce carries into later top purchases and crosspaths.

Proposed early purchases: x-1-x Quick Shots shortens the throw interval so the Unit attacks more often; damage, pierce, range and targeting stay the same, and the faster rate applies to whatever the Unit throws in top and bottom crosspaths. x-2-x Very Quick Shots shortens the throw interval again; every other property stays the same, and the faster rate applies to top and bottom crosspath attacks as well.

omittedTechniques.name: Fan Club allied transformation

omittedTechniques.name: Boost only plasma dart pierce
omittedTechniques.reason: The boost can change only damage, interval and range, so x-5-x gives the extra pierce to every dart at all times, in ordinary volleys and during the boost, instead of only to plasma darts during the ability.

omittedTechniques.name: Sharp Shooter and Crossbow Master critical shots
omittedTechniques.reason: Critical hits on every tenth and every fifth shot need a shot counter, which the Definition lacks; they are not folded into ordinary damage.

omittedTechniques.name: Crossbow Master damage increase
omittedTechniques.reason: The Definition allows four changes per purchase. With the brief's pierce 8 restored, x-x-5 uses them on attack rate, range, pierce and the Normal damage type, so bolt damage stays at the x-x-4 value instead of rising as in the source. This is a deliberate change from the previous unit, which kept the damage increase and left out the pierce increase.

purchaseClaim.buyFor: Dense groups of ordinary enemies moving together along the track, and from 4-x-x groups that contain Lead or Frozen enemies.
purchaseClaim.weakness: Through 3-x-x the ball stays Sharp, so it cannot damage Lead or Frozen enemies until 4-x-x, and the path adds no Camo detection of its own; only an x-x-2 side purchase adds it. Damage per hit stays low, so single tough enemies take many throws, and 3-x-x throws less often than the 2-x-x dart. Rebound, knockback and the Ceramic, Fortified and Lead bonuses are not modeled, and the 5-x-x follow-up reaches at most twelve enemies near the primary target once per throw.
purchaseClaim.capstoneValue: 5-x-x multiplies the ball's pierce, raises its damage per hit and adds a follow-up on every throw that strikes up to twelve more nearby enemies, so one placement handles denser groups per throw than several 4-x-x copies, whose balls each stop at 4-x-x pierce and damage. The higher damage per hit also means fewer throws for each tough enemy, and the whole package sits at one point on the track where placement space may be scarce.

purchaseClaim.buyFor: A steady stream of enemies where many darts per second on the selected target help, and from x-4-x a player timed boost for heavy waves.
